@2024 Kenya National Examination Council Grade 8 Agriculture and Nutrition SBA 1
 Answer all the questions in the spaces provided.
1. Grade 8 learners carried out soil erosion control as shown.
 a) Name the method of soil erosion control they carried out. (1 Mark)
 b) Explain two ways in which the method shown prevents soil erosion. (2 Marks)
2. Grade 8 learners prepared the structure shown for storing surface run off.
 a) Identify the structure illustrated. (1 Mark)
 b) Give two maintenance practices that may be carried out on the structure. (2 Marks)
@2024 Kenya National Examination Council Grade 8 Agriculture and Nutrition SBA 2
3. Grade 8 learners constructed the structure illustrated and used it to rear chicken.
 a) Identify the structure. (1 Mark)
 b) Give two benefits of using the structure while rearing chicken. (2 Marks)
 c) Give three challenges the learners may have experienced when watering the chicken using open
 containers. (3 Marks)
 d). The learners intend to slaughter the chicken once the project is over. Describe four steps the
 learners will follow while dressing the chicken. (4 Marks)
4. Furaha observed some pests on vegetable crops in their kitchen garden at home.
 a) Describe three ways Furaha can use to control the pests. (3 Marks)
@2024 Kenya National Examination Council Grade 8 Agriculture and Nutrition SBA 3
 b) Explain three benefits Furaha’s family gets from the kitchen garden. (3 Marks)
 c) Give three support services Furaha could access online to enhance her crop production. (3 Marks)
5. Grade 8 learners were searching for the importance of preserving meat from the internet. Outline three
 points they may have found. (3 Marks)
6. The school Cateress has asked you to design a menu of a balanced meal for lunch.
 a) State two factors you will consider before designing the menu. (2 Marks)
 b) Write a sample menu you will design. (2 Marks)
7. Muktar is preparing to carry out weekly cleaning of the kitchen. Outline three activities he will undertake
 during the cleaning. (3 Marks)
@2024 Kenya National Examination Council Grade 8 Agriculture and Nutrition SBA 4
8. Kashu has been asked to assess samples of open seams made by Grade 8 learners.
 a) Label the marked parts of the open. (2 Marks)
 b) Outline three qualities of an open seam Kashu will look for while assessing the seams. (3 Marks)
 THIS IS THE LAST PRINTED PAGE
@2024 Kenya National Examination Council Grade 8 Agriculture and Nutrition SBA 5
